cases.claim: The same root cause means any heading whose title legitimately ends with '#' characters followed by a space and a closing hash run (e.g. '# C# #') will also be mis-parsed, because the trailing hashes are absorbed into the text group instead of being treated as the closing sequence.

The same regex defect also affects non-empty trailing closing hashes, e.g. '# Title #' would capture 'Title #' rather than 'Title', so heading/section titles and case-folded lookups would be wrong; inferred from the pattern, not directly executed.
